d: THE HOLLOW CIRCUIT #2 — Ghosts of Sector Nine. Kaarine spots it first: footprints that stop mid-step, at the edge of Neon Row. Starring Maethune (Anor Delglen), Kaarine (Fenmere Imere), Tredrela (Vehollow Jocott), Syllmir (Senor Awen). Neon-row couriers who dive the city's ghost frequencies discover a signal that was never meant to be heard.
